contract.source: Complete maintained sequence with original PNGs, calibrated tasks, requested/presented times and supplied evidence classes.
contract.declarations: Common planar reference, corresponding physical corner meanings, identical dimensions and explicit one-to-one point pairs.
contract.limits: At most 30 point pairs; existing 48 MiB source-bundle bound plus 64 KiB comparison settings and formatting.
contract.recomputation: Reopen binds settings to admitted source and recomputes derived geometry; export rehashes retained PNG bytes.
contract.singleComparison: Selecting another step starts a fresh comparison. Save the current comparison first.

evidenceLimits: Original authored PNGs and independent analytic planar projections; no newly decoded physical demonstration in this course.
Two endpoints do not establish intervening path, distance traveled, instantaneous speed, contact, force or physical necessity.
